observations: Scanfrost brand name is visible on the top right of the control panel in photos 0, 1, and 2.
The appliance has four gas burners on the top surface.
A glass lid is attached and shown in the open position in photos 1 and 2.
There are five control knobs on the front panel.
Significant rust and corrosion are visible on the bottom corners and the lower edge of the frame in photo 0.
The oven door has a 'Self Cleaning Oven' sticker, though the glass appears dirty.
The overall exterior shows heavy use, grime, and signs of age.

claims.evidence: There are no photos showing the burners ignited.
The photos do not show the presence or absence of a power cord or internal ignition components.
The seller explicitly states the oven is not fully functional.

risks.risk: Top burners may be blocked, have poor gas flow, or not work at all.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit at the same time.

risks.risk: The oven burner defect may be due to severe internal corrosion making it unrepairable.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the oven interior and the burner assembly.

risks.risk: Internal gas lines may be compromised by the same rust seen on the exterior, posing a leak hazard.
risks.proof: A video of a soap-bubble leak test on the internal connections.

proof_requests: Video of all four top burners lit and adjusted from high to low.
Photo of the oven interior showing the condition of the burner and racks.
Photo of the manufacturer's plate (usually on the back) to confirm the exact model.
response.reason: The item is a recognizable Scanfrost model. Given the visible heavy rust and the seller's admission of a broken oven, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit or for parts.
